title: SEO Content Briefs
meta: Content briefs with search intent, outline, questions and sources to guide accurate articles. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: SEO content briefs that guide helpful writing
overview: A good brief saves hours of rewrites. For each topic we work out what searchers actually want, then write a brief your writer can follow: the angle, a suggested outline, questions to answer, terms to use naturally and sources worth citing. We use AI tools for research speed and a person for judgment. Briefs focus on being helpful and accurate, not on stuffing keywords. They suit your own writer, a freelancer or an AI assisted draft.

faq: Do briefs promise page one rankings?
No. Nobody can promise rankings. Briefs raise the chance your article answers the search well, and results still depend on your site, competition and time.
Do you write the articles too?
Briefs only. For the writing itself, see Blog and Article Drafts, which you can order separately. Many clients give our brief to their own writer, and it works with any writer.
Which keyword tools do you use?
We use public search data, search results pages and the data you can give us, such as Search Console access as a viewer. We do not need paid tool accounts from you.
Can the briefs work for e-commerce?
Yes. We can write briefs for buying guides, comparison posts and category pages, linking to your products naturally. We avoid thin pages that exist only to chase search terms.
